changes: Added semantic scope contract v2 fields, mechanical scope diff packs, semantic hunk gating, guarded session projection, reviewer scope/diff binding, and a session_brief scope protection summary for story-scoped changes.
usage: Use scope_contract_set/show/check, scope_diff_pack, guard_session_start/status/check, review_run_start/review_pass_set, and session_brief to declare scope, inspect real diffs, bind reviewer evidence, and surface protection status before lifecycle transitions.
expectedOutcome: Koala should prevent or warn on out-of-scope and semantically protected changes, bind reviewer approval to current scope/diff hashes, and expose replayable evidence instead of accepting natural-language-only approval.

Claude delivery reviewer ran test:semantic-scope-guard-smoke, test:scope-contract-smoke, runtime-fact-contract, command-ownership-contract, lifecycle-registry-contract, live scope_diff_pack, live scope_contract_show, and live session_brief; delivery_check_set saved 8 docsPromises and 6 realMachineTests with 0 waivers. outcomeDiff: Expected behavior was delivered. Two acknowledged scope path warnings remain for test-support files and are intentionally recorded as advisory, not blockers.
limitations: Guard session is a story projection and provider-aware fallback, not universal OS-level pre-tool blocking. Unsupported providers may run in watcher-fallback mode. Existing stories without scope contracts remain backward compatible.
